title: Embeddings pipeline: compact tear-sheet + sample output cards for onboarding play
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a compact one-page tear-sheet and a set of 6 sample output cards to support the new Embeddings + Rerank quickstart in the docs and console. Focus is a lightweight pipeline diagram (single-row flow with optional expanders), three example query workflows (semantic search, FAQ rerank, and similarity match), and screenshot-ready card assets optimized for mobile and desktop docs. Deliverables: SVG pipeline, high-DPI PNGs, annotated sample outputs, and recommended microcopy and alt-text.
acceptance_criteria: SVG pipeline (single-row) exported with separate layers for labels and arrows
6 sample output cards produced: 3 desktop wides, 3 mobile stacked; each with original and reranked examples
All assets added to drive + figma and referenced in docs PR
Microcopy for tooltips and callouts reviewed by PM and Eng and finalized
Accessibility: alt-text written for each image and color contrast passes WCAG AA
design_notes: Primary visual language should match Console 2026: use System Blue for embeddings, Teal for rerank phase, and Neutral 600 for annotations.

Compact pipeline uses a single horizontal swimlane: Data -> Embed -> Index -> Query -> Rerank -> Output. Each step is a tappable expander in the console; the tear-sheet shows collapsed and expanded states side-by-side.
Prefer 16px iconography grid; export assets at 1x, 2x for retina and 3x for high-density displays.
Sample outputs emphasize differences introduced by rerank: include confidence scores, original rank, and delta score to make improvement tangible for new users.
